questions.stem: A food sample gives the following results: Benedict's test stays blue, iodine stays brown-orange, Biuret test turns purple. Which molecule is present in the sample?
questions.explanation: Only the Biuret test was positive (purple colour change), indicating protein is present. The negative Benedict's test (stayed blue) means no reducing sugar, and the negative iodine test (stayed brown-orange) means no starch.
